# Cirth v0.8.5

Cirth v0.8.5 is a bug-fix release focused on grouped controls and
cross-browser form behavior. It fixes native validation feedback, hidden
metadata in groups, date-like controls in narrow grids, and nav dropdown
sizing in Firefox. No breaking changes.

## Fixed

- **Native validation stays neutral after valid interaction** (gh#83):
  automatic styles now react only to `:user-invalid`; `:user-valid` remains
  neutral unless explicitly marked with `aria-invalid="false"`.
- **Hidden fields no longer flatten group outer corners** (gh#68): the first
  and last visible item calculation now ignores `[hidden]` elements and
  hidden inputs.
- **Date-like inputs shrink inside grouped grid columns** (gh#70): paired
  date ranges remain on one row in narrow grid columns across browser
  engines.
- **Nav dropdown menus stay anchored in Firefox** (gh#72): each menu uses a
  stable containing block instead of being sized against the viewport.

See the [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#085---2026-08-15)
for the complete, itemized list.
